name: Legend Battles
detailed_description:
Unreal Engine 5.6, Easy Anti-Cheat, AWS GameLift, Hanxiang gaming technologies come together to redefine next-gen Free To Play Battle Royale genre!

 

LEGEND BATTLES catapults you into a breathtaking and hyper-realistic universe of 400 km² of rocky mountain desert, where hundreds of futuristic megacities with dense infrastructures populated by thousands of buildings with richly furnished interiors, whose roofs are accessible and equipped for combat, and rather cyberpunk basements. Spaceships, that can be accessed via zip lines, add epic aerial combat and mid-air battles. Customization of the MetaHumans, MetaHairs and clothing, which are all interchangeable, is achieved with millions of combinations. Environments and thousands of vehicles are partially destructible to gain tactical advantages. Thousands of guns offer realistic mechanics, recoil and ballistics with various attachments to impact their performance.

 

Unreal Engine 5.6 Lumen global illumination and reflections system, Nanite high-fidelity geometry, Chaos Physics destructible environment and vehicles, MetaSounds immersive directional audio for footsteps, vehicles and gunfire, will be unlike anything we’ve seen in previous battle royales to give players a truly vast playground to explore, survive, and fight in.

 

In short, Unreal Engine 5.6 makes LEGEND BATTLES a next-gen masterpiece designed to create the most immersive and tactical experience possible by delivering groundbreaking visuals, interactivity, and realism that will redefine the battle royale genre!

ENTER THE BATTLE ROYALE REVOLUTION: LEGEND BATTLES

Welcome to the most ambitious battle royale ever conceived. LEGEND BATTLES catapults you into a stunning 400 km² hyper-realistic universe, where hundreds of futuristic megacities with dense infrastructures, interconnected by vast road networks, fully explorable thousands of buildings, and zipline-accessible spaceships create the ultimate tactical playground.

 

Suit up as your fully customizable Metahuman avatar with millions of combinations, and dive into adrenaline-fueled showdowns with thousands of realistic weapons and destructible vehicles speeding at 400 km/h (250 mph). But this is more than survival—this is a second life: race through neon streets, fight legendary creatures, ride helicopters over cyberpunk skylines, or chill with friends atop glowing skyscrapers.

 

Powered by Unreal Engine 5.6 that runs smoothly at 60 FPS on current-generation hardware with Lumen, Nanite, Chaos, MetaSounds, MetaHumans and AWS GameLift, LEGEND BATTLES isn’t just a game. It’s a living, breathing world, a crossroads of cultures, strategy, freedom, and firepower.

 

LEGEND BATTLES: Where your legend begins. September 19, 2025. Be ready.

FIVE-DIMENSIONAL REVOLUTION IN COMPETITIVE GAMING

 

Enter a stunning 400 km² world crafted with Unreal Engine 5.6, where hundreds of megacities sprawl across rocky deserts, each bursting with unique architecture, richly furnished interiors, cyberpunk basements, and combat-ready rooftops. These cities aren’t just maps—they’re living, breathing ecosystems, designed to immerse and surprise at every corner.

 

Explore skyscrapers, sci-fi libraries, alien temples, nightclubs, and suspended space stations—all fully accessible. Scale walls, leap across rooftops, zipline into enemy airships, or race through neon-lit avenues. No spot is off-limits. Combat unfolds on every vertical plane: ground, balconies, rooftops, basements, and even orbit.

 

Customize your Metahuman avatar with millions of outfit combinations. Equip thousands of weapons and vehicles with realistic physics, ballistics, and destruction. Powered by Lumen, Nanite, Chaos, and Metasound 5.6 technologies, the experience is intensely visual, tactile, and strategic.

 

Whether you're surviving solo or fighting with your squad, LEGEND BATTLES is more than a game. It’s a world. A challenge. A second life.

THE SKY IS YOUR ARENA

 

In LEGEND BATTLES, flight isn’t just transportation—it’s pure adrenaline.

 

Soar from your dropship in a high-tech flight suit powered by jet packs and glowing with epic skins. Beneath you, an endless sea of futuristic megacities. Around you, total freedom.

 

You glide with precision, navigating the skies toward your chosen landing zone. But this isn’t a gentle descent—it's a tactical choice. Land on the streets, in a hidden alley, or atop a skyscraper primed for combat.

 

Touch down, detach, and gear up—your fight begins. Hunt for weapons, armor, and supplies… or claim the rooftops and dominate with a sniper rifle and a long-range scope. Every rooftop is a battleground, every structure a potential advantage.

 

Leap from buildings, parachute in vibrant patterns, or make a last-second escape using ziplines. But beware—ambushes await. And if you’re lucky enough to find a helicopter, prepare for aerial chaos: ride with your squad, rain down fire from above, and enjoy the view—until an RPG lights you up.

 

In the skies of LEGEND BATTLES, there’s no safe zone—only endless action, constant movement, and unforgettable moments. Fly smart. Land fast. Survive the fall.

SURVIVAL BEGINS THE MOMENT YOU LAND

 

In LEGEND BATTLES, there’s no warm-up. The second your boots hit the ground, chaos erupts. Bullets fly, enemies close in, and every second is a fight for survival. Grab whatever you can—rifles, gear, medical kits—don’t think, just survive.

 

Outfit yourself fast: ballistic helmet, armored vest, tactical backpack. Equip dual rifles, sidearms, grenades, smoke bombs of every color, and maybe even a combat-ready electric guitar. Style is welcome, but survival comes first.

 

Airdrops offer elite gear—but they’re deadly traps too. Use smoke, loot fast, escape smarter. And always keep your eyes on the true prize: energy capsules. These rare resources are key to enduring the storm as the map tightens, phase by phase, and death waits beyond the shrinking circle.

 

But the planet is as dangerous as the players. Electromagnetic tornadoes—massive, violent, unpredictable—tear through the landscape. Misread their path, and you're gone.

 

Urban warfare in LEGEND BATTLES is brutal and beautiful. Towering megacities hide ambushes around every corner—stairwells, office blocks, underground garages, rooftops. You’ll fight in vertical mazes packed with fully accessible interiors, where danger and opportunity lurk on every floor.

 

Climb everything. Lampposts, towers, rooftops, cranes—nothing’s off-limits. Smash windows, infiltrate high-rises, strike from above. Or zip across the skyline like a missile, descending on your enemies in a flash.

 

Powered by cutting-edge tech and next-gen engine design, LEGEND BATTLES redefines the battle royale. No limits. No comfort zones. Just full-scale, high-stakes, hyper-realistic urban combat.

 

LEGEND BATTLES – This is not just a fight. It’s a war like never before.

RULE THE ROAD, DOMINATE THE SKIES

 

In LEGEND BATTLES, vehicles aren’t just transportation—they’re weapons, shields, and statements of power. From blazing-fast racing cars that push past 406 km/h to rugged off-road 4x4s, from sniper-ready pickups to bulletproof military trucks and squad-carrying helicopters, every vehicle is a tactical choice and a thrill ride.

 

Choose your style: muscle cars for speed, buggies for chaos, motorcycles for agility, or armored vehicles for dominance. Motorbikes can leap down staircases, 4x4s smash through doors, and helicopters become flying fortresses—until a well-aimed RPG turns them into a fireball.

 

Every model is destructible. Tires burst. Engines explode. Doors rip off. One ambush can turn your ride into a deathtrap. And don’t forget: fuel is survival. Run out, and you’re stranded in enemy territory.

 

Fly through megacities, climb rooftops with off-road beasts, or turn highways into battlegrounds. Whether you're speeding across deserts or zipping between skyscrapers, your vehicle is your lifeline—and your legacy.

 

LEGEND BATTLES – Drive fast. Fly hard. Conquer everything.

FIREPOWER, FURY, AND FULL-SCALE DESTRUCTION

 

In LEGEND BATTLES, armored vehicles and helicopters aren’t just transportation—they’re iconic machines of war. With stunning designs, immersive interiors like all vehicles, and dazzling skins, the four types of armored vehicles deliver cinematic realism and formidable presence. But beware: they're not invincible. Precision strikes from grenade launchers, miniguns or well-coordinated ambushes can turn them into smoldering wrecks in seconds. Their rarity makes them highly coveted—and lethal in the right hands.

 

Take to the skies in high-speed helicopters, where coordinated teams become predators from above. With a gunner manning a Minigun and a skilled pilot at the controls, few can escape the chaos. But danger is never far—snipers, rooftop LMGs, and well-placed shots to turbines or fuel tanks can bring even the most powerful aircraft crashing down.

 

And the arsenal doesn’t stop there. RPGs punch through vehicles and buildings alike. Grenade launchers unleash rapid devastation. Heavy machine guns provide cover or pinpoint precision. And the Minigun? A six-barrel monster firing up to 6,000 rounds per minute—unstoppable when paired with an aerial strike.

 

Then there’s the flamethrower—an infernal weapon that ignites not just enemies, but panic itself. It disorients, blinds, and breaks lines. Used correctly, it can turn tight corridors into blazing traps of doom.

 

In LEGEND BATTLES, combat is relentless, and no machine or weapon guarantees survival. But wielded with skill, they tip the scales—and define the legends.

WHERE TEAMWORK HEALS AND RESURRECTION IS REAL

 

In LEGEND BATTLES, every firefight could be your last—but survival isn’t just about firepower, it’s about who has your back. The battlefield is brutal, but it's also where true camaraderie shines.

 

Medical kits—bandages, energy drinks, painkillers, adrenaline shots, and cardiovascular injectors—are scattered across the terrain, offering lifelines when you're hanging by a thread. Healing is fast and intuitive, turning moments of desperation into chances to fight again.

 

But the real strength lies in your squad. When you're down, a teammate dives through gunfire, lobs smoke grenades, and risks everything to revive you. Ten seconds of vulnerability. Ten seconds of loyalty. And then—you're back on your feet, pulsing with adrenaline, ready to return the favor.

 

Team coordination is everything. While one lays suppressing fire, others advance. Smoke grenades become walls of survival. Tactical synergy separates ordinary players from true legends.

 

Even death isn’t the end. If you recover a fallen ally’s resurrection chip, you can bring them back—through towering, high-risk resurrection stations. If successful, a dropship returns your comrade to the skies, parachuting back into the fray, unarmed and exposed. And that’s your cue: cover their descent. Guard their return.

 

In LEGEND BATTLES, healing is more than survival—it's sacrifice, strategy, and solidarity. Because here, we never abandon our loved ones.

Optional in-game purchases available.

supported_languages: English, Italian, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Polish, Thai, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America, Arabic, Korean, Hindi, French, German

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400, AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060, AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 95 GB available space
  • Sound Card: No Recommendation
  • VR Support: Not Supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD is required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700, AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060Ti, AMD Radeon RX 6700-XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 95 GB available space
  • Sound Card: No Recommendation
  • VR Support: Not Supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD is required
